UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: User account and role-based section access permissions for the OKKAM Warehouse Suite.

uid.description: Owner UID or account creator UID matching request.auth.uid.

login.description: Unique login username or email address for the account.

displayName.description: Full name or position description of the employee.

role.description: Access role: 'admin' has full access and user management; 'user' has access only to allowedSections.

allowedSections.description: Bounded list of section slugs (up to 25) that this user is allowed to open.

active.description: Whether the account is active and permitted to sign in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last updated.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Trusted administrator registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin marker was created.

/users/{userId}.description: User accounts and section access profiles managed by administrators and readable by their owner.
